            b_cols = [p[1] for p in b['boundary']]
            b_center = ((min(b_rows)+max(b_rows))//2, (min(b_cols)+max(b_cols))//2)
            a_rows = [p[0] for p in a['boundary']]
            a_cols = [p[1] for p in a['boundary']]
            a_center = ((min(a_rows)+max(a_rows))//2, (min(a_cols)+max(a_cols))//2)
